caseNameFull: John F. Montgomery, Managing Owner, etc. v. C. W. Chatfield, Master, etc.

opinions.text: Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit denied. Mr. Edward E. Blodgett, Mr. R. G. Bickford and Mr. Frederick W. Eaton for petitioners. Mr. Robert M. Hughes and Mr. James D. Dewell, Jr., for respondent.
